description: Arrow & Branch's 2012 Napa Valley Red Wine is a Cabernet Franc-led Bordeaux blend with blackberry depth, floral lift, and a polished mocha undertone. Integrated tannins and lively acidity give the mature wine shape without sacrificing generosity.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2012 Arrow & Branch Napa Valley Red Wine.
palate: Rounded dark fruit, bright acidity, integrated tannin
sommelierNotes: Give the wine an hour of air and serve with herb-crusted lamb, beef tenderloin, or roasted mushrooms.
